_doc: Owner-curated next-tool recommendations. Each entry says: when the named tool finishes with the given signal pattern, recommend the listed tool. The first matching entry wins; if no entry matches, the recommender returns null (the calling tool shows no card). Only live, on-funnel tools may appear as `from` or `to` — the recommender's resolveUrl() builds /tools/<slug>/ with no existence check, so a retired slug would ship a 301-looping card. The 2026-06 product-only migration retired the SEO/services tools (audits/restaurant, gbp-grader, store-hours, storefront-health, menu-copy, photo-brief, menu-converter, brand-suite, page-health, seo-grader, schema-check, tech-stack, compare, search-ideas) and the 17-tool museum's cross-links were pruned here on 2026-07-11 — the whole retired-`from`/`to` rule set went with them. The post-consolidation handoff flow (what margin-math and menu-engineering should recommend next now that menu-copy/menu-converter are gone) is a Phase-3 tools-loop decision, not a stopgap repoint. Editing rule: keep this file small and live-only. Schema validated by scripts/check-next-tool-map.mjs (TODO: write).
